context: M21 o8b (burned branch). Lisle's office, lamplight. Teddy lifts the whole ledger.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: No copies. No wire. Just the book. He'll know by morning.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: First page: October seventy-one. C.M. Carl. The night I waited in the car.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Whoever holds this owns the Tenderloin. Tonight that's me.
